email-notifications.title: Workspace Email Notifications
email-notifications.source: Neon Deer Data Labs (block schemas read from the app source)
email-notifications.connection: Sign up (free) at https://app.neondeerdata.com, then in Attio go to Workspace settings > Apps > Email Notifications and connect Neon Deer.
email-notifications.connection_failure: Step errors with "Email notifications isn't connected to this organization."
guidance: Setup at https://app.neondeerdata.com/email-notifications/setup needs BOTH connections: "Workspace access" (reads the member list) and "Email alerts" (the Attio app).

Email alerts are OFF by default. An org admin must switch them on at https://app.neondeerdata.com/email-notifications?view=settings, or every send is refused ("Email alerts are turned off for this organization.").
The outcome "queued" does NOT mean sent. Plan-limit, inactive-recipient and bounce failures show only in the portal Activity view (?view=activity), never in the Attio run.
Free plan: 20 emails a month. Over the allowance the step still reports "queued" and the alert is marked Not sent in the portal.
No templates, sender choice or domain setup. Sender is fixed; subject prefix, BCC and rate limits live in the portal settings view.
global_notes: One step block, send-email-notification. No triggers.
The step completes with outcome 'queued' as soon as Neon Deer has queued the alert. 'queued' does not prove sending or inbox delivery.
Plan and capability checks happen on the Neon Deer platform, not in the Attio app.
subject has a UI-only maxLength of 100; via API a longer subject is accepted and shortened with a trailing '…'. No UI defaults are lost when config is written via API.
Outcome 'queued' has schema {} and runtime data null: the step exposes no output variables.
If the workspace connection setup is incomplete, the step finishes the connection itself and retries once.

send-email-notification.title: Send email notification
send-email-notification.description: Send an alert to an Attio workspace member through Neon Deer.

config.notes: Configurator restricts to ActorType.WORKSPACE_MEMBER. Runtime rejects any other actorType with non-retryable 'Choose an Attio workspace member as the recipient.' Only actorId is sent (as memberId); the API validates it as a GUID. One recipient per step: no raw email address, list, team or multi-recipient option. The platform resolves the address from Attio's live member list at send time; a member whose accessLevel is not admin/member is 'Not sent: the recipient isn't an active member of this Attio workspace'.

UI maxLength 100. Help: "Your Neon Deer organization's subject prefix is added automatically." Runtime trims and shortens to 100 with '…'. Platform builds '<prefix> <subject>'; default prefix 'Attio alert: [<Org name>]'. API requires one line (no control chars, so no newlines) and at least 1 char after trim: blank or multi-line subject gets 422 invalid_request.

UI label 'Message'. RichTextInput with every format disabled (links, lists, quotes, H1-H3, bold, italic, underline, strikethrough); rich text is used only for line breaks. Runtime converts with value.toPlainText(); a legacy plain string (steps saved when body was ConfigSchema.string) is still accepted. Anything else becomes '' and the API refuses it (422). Help: 'Plain text, up to 2,000 characters; anything longer is shortened. Include a record link if helpful.' Shortened at 2000 with '… (message shortened)'.

outcomes.condition: Neon Deer accepted the alert (state pending, sending or accepted). Label 'Queued'.

mismatches: None between source and live surfaces: one step send-email-notification plus workspace settings, as installed.
Outcome id changed from 'sent' to 'queued' in v1.0. Any workflow built against 'sent' is stale.
The live install (v1.0) declares the 'queued' outcome and a rich-text body.

check-for-duplicates.title: Duplicate Detection & Merging
check-for-duplicates.source: Neon Deer Data Labs (block schemas read from the app source)
check-for-duplicates.connection: Sign up (free) at https://app.neondeerdata.com, then in Attio go to Workspace settings > Apps > Duplicate Detection & Merging and connect Neon Deer.
guidance: Setup at https://app.neondeerdata.com/duplicates/setup: "Workspace access" plus "Automatic detection" (the Attio app).
Rules (match fields, exclusions) at https://app.neondeerdata.com/duplicates/rules; scans at /duplicates/scans and /duplicates/schedules.
Duplicates are reviewed, sorted and merged at https://app.neondeerdata.com/duplicates/sets. Exclusions at /duplicates/not-duplicates; settings (kept record, merge limits) at /duplicates/settings.
The platform is the only merge authority. Do not build workflows that auto-merge people or companies; send the human to /duplicates/sets instead.
A merge (Attio POST /v2/objects/{object}/records/merge) always mints a NEW record id. Workflows, scheduled runs and lookup-table record cells keyed to the old id will point at a dead record.
Merges run pair by pair in batches, so record created/updated/deleted workflows on people and companies can fire in bursts.
UNVERIFIED: whether a merge fires record.deleted, i.e. whether AWA "Record deleted" (k-record-deleted) workflows run on merged-away records. Test in a sandbox before relying on either behaviour.

The Attio app provisions two lists, "Duplicate Companies" (company_deduplication_history) and "Duplicate People" (person_deduplication_history), with attributes duplicate_reason, duplicate_of, input_value, matched_value, details and merged (checkbox), plus a timestamp attribute nddl_last_duplicate_check on people and companies. Slugs may carry a suffix; check the workspace before referencing them (they only exist once the app has run in the workspace).

Each flagged duplicate becomes a list entry, and merged flips to true when Attio reports record.merged. Workflows can trigger on entries added to those lists or filter on merged; do not build workflows that edit the duplicate_* attributes.
Apart from nddl_last_duplicate_check, detection writes nothing to people or company records. The Attio app itself never merges.
Free plan: 5 scans and 200 merge pairs a month; redirect-domain checks and AI confidence are paid only.
